purpose: Standardize how Dwellings, nested Rooms, pages and artifacts can have local focal centers while preserving Potato of Life as global semantic center and Axis as global spatial center.

scope_types.example: Culture & Information may center on Formation while still orbiting Potato center.
Subculture & Group Formation may center on norm/identity transition.
History page centers on occurrence→source→memory→canon pipeline.
A song or diagram may have its own compositional focal point.

rules: Local center organizes attention and handoff inside a bounded context.
Local centers inherit global epistemic boundaries and cannot redefine project canon.
A local axis/plane is a view/projection only; it does not create a rival cosmos.
Every local center must expose exits back to parent scope and onward to mature handoff targets.
If a local center starts accumulating unrelated ownership, split/redirect ownership rather than promoting it into another global center.
